wines.label: Pauillac
wines.tasting_note: In the glass, Château Lynch-Bages Pauillac opens with aromas of blackcurrant, cedar, graphite, and a touch of tobacco leaf that reflect its classic Left Bank Bordeaux character. On the palate, the wine shows a full-bodied structure layered with cassis, dark chocolate, and herbal nuances, where the Cabernet Sauvignon provides firm backbone while the Merlot adds supple roundness. It finishes long and elegant, with polished tannins and a mineral persistence that suggests excellent aging potential.

wines.tasting_note: The Château Léoville Barton Saint-Julien reveals aromas of blackcurrant, cedar, and graphite laced with violet and tobacco leaf. On the palate it delivers concentrated flavors of cassis and plum framed by firm, polished tannins and a medium- to full-bodied structure typical of the appellation. The finish is long and elegant, with lingering notes of leather and spice that underscore its classic Bordeaux poise and age-worthiness.
